# REST tools

`client.restTools` → `/api/v1/developer/rest-tools` + code-first `defineRestTool`.

```ts
import{} from '@personaai/sdk/rest-tools';
import{} from 'zod';
const getProfile = defineRestTool({
  name: 'Get profile',
  method: 'GET',
  args: z.object{}),
  url: t => `https://api.coursify.dev/users/{}`,
});
```
